newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran bridge collapses killing four, injuring five.
newsitem.headline: Iran bridge collapses killing four, injuring five.

text.p: A bridge collapsed in northern Iran killing four people and injuring five, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported on Wednesday.
A fire brigade official said a pick-up truck and a car were buried in the rubble, IRNA said.
The reason for the collapse of the bridge near Tehran late on Tuesday had not yet been determined but investigations were underway, it said.
"Three relief and rescue teams from the fire brigade rushed to the scene of the accident as soon as it happened and operations to clear the rubble continued until after midnight," IRNA said.
